pipelines.name: Test Release Scripts

steps.name: Install bats-core
steps.run: sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -q -y bats

steps.name: Configure Git identity for tests
steps.run:
git config --global user.name "CI"
git config --global user.email "ci@test"

steps.name: Run bats tests
steps.run: bats release/tests/*.bats

steps.name: Verify scripts are executable
steps.run:
for script in release/bin/*.sh; do
  if [[ ! -x "$script" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: $script is not executable"
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "All scripts are executable"

steps.run:

KEY_ID=$(gpg --list-keys --with-colons | grep '^fpr' | head -1 | cut -d: -f10)
git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git config --global user.signingkey "${KEY_ID}"
git config --global commit.gpgsign true

pipelines.name: Vector-plugins

build.name: Build Parquet with JDK ${{ matrix.java }} and ${{ matrix.codes }}

steps.name: before_install
steps.run: bash dev/ci-before_install.sh

steps.name: install
steps.run:
# Spotless check uses palantir-java-format which relies on internal javac APIs
# that are not available on all JDK versions (e.g. JDK 25+). Since the formatting
# result is JDK-independent, running the check on JDK 17 alone is sufficient.
SPOTLESS_ARGS=""
if [ "${{ matrix.java }}" != "17" ]; then
  SPOTLESS_ARGS="-Dspotless.check.skip=true"
fi
./mvnw install --batch-mode -Pvector-plugins -DskipTests=true -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true -Dsource.skip=true -Dmaven.buildNumber.skip=true $SPOTLESS_ARGS -Djava.version=${{ matrix.java }} -pl parquet-plugins/parquet-encoding-vector,parquet-plugins/parquet-plugins-benchmarks -am

steps.name: verify
steps.run:
# Spotless check uses palantir-java-format which relies on internal javac APIs
# that are not available on all JDK versions (e.g. JDK 25+). Since the formatting
# result is JDK-independent, running the check on JDK 17 alone is sufficient.
SPOTLESS_ARGS=""
if [ "${{ matrix.java }}" != "17" ]; then
  SPOTLESS_ARGS="-Dspotless.check.skip=true"
fi
./mvnw verify --batch-mode -Pvector-plugins javadoc:javadoc $SPOTLESS_ARGS -pl parquet-plugins/parquet-encoding-vector,parquet-plugins/parquet-plugins-benchmarks -am
